greet.text: Mind the furnace, it bites. I am Hua Qingyi; I go wherever the herbs are cheap and the buyers are rich. Are you buying, selling or just breathing my pill smoke?

choices.label: Sell her a Flame Lotus. (+45 stones)
Sell her 3 Purple Cloud Mushrooms. (+55 stones)
Tend her furnace for ten days.
Slip a handful of pills from her drying rack.

greet_friend.text: {player}! Sit, sit. The furnace has been sulking all morning; perhaps it likes you better than me.

choices.label: Tend her furnace for ten days.
Ask her to teach you the Spirit Gathering formula.
Commission a Foundation Establishment Pill. (Flame Lotus, Ice Soul Flower, 100 stones)

craft.text: Patience, a nose for scorched qi, and never trusting a pill you did not refine yourself. Learn the Alchemist profession at a workshop; formulas come from scrolls, and the good ones from friends.

tend.text: Not one batch burned. Here, two of the better ones. Do not sell them to that rat Qian.

steal.text: She turns back to the furnace a moment too late. When she counts the rack, her eyes find you and go cold.

teach.text: You have earned it. Spirit Gathering is simple in theory: four spirit herbs for the base, one purple cloud mushroom to bind them. Copy the slip and keep it from the sects; they charge a fortune for this.

commission.text: Three days and three nights, and only one pill out of the batch survived. It is yours. Break through well, {player}; I like having friends who live long.
